The prices are based all displayed as per month but annual plans are billed annually.
Prices for each plan are:

- Pro: $<validate>19</validate>/month (annual billing) and $<validate>29</validate>/month (monthly billing)
- Team: $<validate>234</validate>/month (annual billing) and $<validate>349</validate>/month (monthly billing)
- Enterprise: <validate>custom pricing</validate>
Extra Actions are <validate>$40 per 1,000</validate> actions
Extra Credits are <validate>$20 per 10,000</validate> credits.
